nodes.label: Sequelize Public Class Field Shadowing Issue
nodes.rationale: Sequelize models using `public` TypeScript class field declarations shadow Sequelize's automatically generated getters and setters. Fix: replace `public id!: number` with `declare id: number`. Applied to all 32 model files. `declare` informs TypeScript without creating a real property, preserving Sequelize's attribute management while maintaining type safety.
